summary: Master Learning ROI to quantify training impact and justify L&D investments. Enroll in our 5-day course to learn Phillips’ Methodology and build ROI frameworks.
lede: Measuring learning and development ROI helps L&D professionals assess training investments through business outcomes, not satisfaction alone. This course covers setting baselines and KPIs, isolating training effects with control groups or trend analysis, and converting performance changes into benefits and ROI calculations so you can build an evidence-based impact report for stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who must quantify training value and justify L&D investments to executive stakeholders.
modules: Foundations of Learning ROI and Evaluation Planning
Data Collection Strategies and Baseline Measurement
Isolating Training Effects from External Factors
Converting Performance Data to Monetary Values
Calculating ROI and Building Benefit-to-Cost Models
Developing Executive Impact Studies and Reporting
Automating ROI Tracking and Continuous Improvement
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Intermediate understanding of L&D processes and basic familiarity with performance metrics. Working knowledge of Excel or similar spreadsheet tools is required for calculation exercises. No advanced statistical background or coding skills are needed. Participants should bring a real or hypothetical training program scenario to apply the frameworks during the course.
